page.overview:
Who is Mril Thorion?

Mril Thorion is an Outer God who, along with Mlandoth, serve as Yin and Yang. (: "Where Yidhra Walks")

Mril Thorion, together with Mlandoth generated a “vortex” by being omnipresent throughout all time and space and continuously intersecting with one another; this vortex gave rise to all. (: "Prologue: Collector's item")

Mlandoth and Mril Thorion were created by Walter C. DeBill Jr., but were suggested years earlier by Clark Ashton Smith.
